SMTO-EXE-0159 — SMTO built a desktop instruction it couldn't use

GUID: 80b02ec3-ed68-54f3-903f-cc4c565b85b0
Slug: ui-invalid-request
Domain: EXE · Subsystem: ui

What happened

  • SMTO's instruction for working in an app on the Gateway's computer was incomplete or in a form the Gateway doesn't accept, so nothing was clicked or typed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. In the conversation, ask SMTO to take a fresh look at the app and then try that step again. A fresh look gives SMTO the app's current buttons and fields to build a correct instruction.
  2. Describe the target by its visible name, such as "the Save button in the Export window". A clear, specific name helps SMTO find exactly one matching control.
  3. For a keyboard shortcut, give one main key plus any of Ctrl, Shift, Alt or the Windows or Command key, such as Ctrl+S. The Gateway accepts shortcuts with only one main key, pressed together with those extra keys.

What success looks like

  • SMTO performs the step and reports the result in the conversation.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO; the details show which kind of instruction was rejected. This attempt didn't change anything on the computer.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Desktop UI request validation rejected an unknown operation, a schema violation, a disallowed or non-finite number, an invalid key combination or an invalid selector or visual target before dispatch.

What this means

  • UI validation rejected an unknown operation, invalid closed-schema structure, floating-point argument, unsupported key combination or invalid selector. Numeric budgets are bounded by the existing validator separately. Only the existing explicit UI request may observe or mutate the selected desktop. Secure values stay redacted, stale references are not retargeted, and uncertain native input is not automatically repeated.

Why this can happen

  • UI validation rejected an unknown operation, invalid closed-schema structure, floating-point argument, unsupported key combination or invalid selector. Numeric budgets are bounded by the existing validator separately.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the current schema, integer fields, key order and exact target selectors with the submitted request.

How to fix it

  • Validate the arguments against gateway_core.ui.contract.SCHEMAS for the operation: integers only outside visual targets, key_press with exactly one non-modifier key placed last, window_id for window_client points, display_id for screen_logical points, and draw_path points inside the visual target box. Take a fresh scoped ui.snapshot only if element references are stale.
  • Correct the specific schema or selector error using the advertised operation contract; a fresh snapshot is needed only when target evidence is stale.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect ui.status and a fresh scoped ui.snapshot on the selected Gateway. Correct the target or prerequisites before retrying.

How to verify the fix

  • The intended request validates before native input under normal target and permission checks.

What not to do

  • Do not replay uncertain mutations, read secure fields, record input or bypass OS permissions.

Technical notes

  • Only the existing explicit UI request may observe or mutate the selected desktop. Secure values stay redacted, stale references are not retargeted, and uncertain native input is not automatically repeated.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
